docs.title: Mustafa Schmidt — Full Curriculum Vitae
docs.text:
IT System Engineer · Physicist · High-Performance Computing

Siegen, Germany ORCID: 0000-0002-4467-2461

docs.title: Profile
docs.text: IT system engineer and physicist with professional experience in high-performance computing, scientific software, particle-detector development, Monte Carlo simulation, data analysis, university teaching, student supervision, and science communication. Experienced in maintaining research computing infrastructure and supporting scientific communities through the HPC.NRW network.

docs.title: Research Interests
docs.text:
• Particle physics and medical physics
  • Particle-detector and readout-system development
  • Monte Carlo simulations
  • Front-end electronics
  • Reconstruction algorithms
  • Scientific data analysis
  • Artificial neural networks
  • Science communication and outreach
